# Week 5b {.unnumbered}

## 1.1  Decimal Numbers {.unnumbered}

Express 0.142 as a proper fraction in its simplest form. $1\frac{3}{200}$

1. Express 0.015 as a proper fraction in its simplest form.
$\frac{83}{250}$

2. Express 4.6 as a mixed fraction in its simplest form.
$4\frac{3}{5}$

3. Write $\frac{1}{100}+\frac{5}{1000}$ as a decimal number. 0.015
